_provenance: Distractor memories: the 10 demo learnings from scripts/seed-demo.sh plus 10 hand-written engineering near-misses that share vocabulary with the tasks but do not answer them.

learnings.title: UTM naming for campaigns: utm_campaign = q4-{region}-{product}
learnings.body: Every paid and owned link uses utm_campaign=<quarter>-<region>-<product>, lowercase, hyphens only. Region codes: eu, us, apac. Product codes: esg, ehs, cmd. Example: q4-eu-esg. Anything else breaks the attribution dashboard.

learnings.title: Brand toolkit 2026 lives in the Marketing SharePoint under Brand/2026
learnings.body: Fonts: Urbanist for headings, Inter for body, Inconsolata for code. Primary teal #00B0A1, navy #1A3360. Never use the 2023 palette (the coral was retired).

learnings.title: Pricing quotes need legal review before they leave the building
learnings.body: Any quote with non-standard terms (multi-year, custom SLA, data residency) goes to Legal first. Standard price list quotes do not. Turnaround is usually two working days.

learnings.title: A customer in the automotive sector requires a signed NDA before any demo
learnings.body: Ask the account owner for the NDA template; it is on the Sales SharePoint under Templates/NDA. Do not share screenshots or sample data before it is signed.

learnings.title: The export service needs the VPN for NuGet restore
learnings.body: dotnet restore in acme.export.* fails with a timeout when off the VPN because nuget.config points at an internal package feed. This is a setup problem, not a broken repo.

learnings.title: Run tests with the repo test script, never bare dotnet test
learnings.body: The repo test script is what CI runs: it wires loggers, coverage and dependency containers. Check it starts with set -ex or a failing test exits 0 and CI goes silently green.

learnings.title: kubectl contexts: the dev cluster is the default, a prod one exists too
learnings.body: Check the current context before running anything. It can be left on prod after an incident. Give az and kubectl calls an explicit timeout: they hang rather than fail when the VPN is down.

learnings.title: Client names never go into shared notes; describe the sector instead
learnings.body: Write a customer in the pharma sector, not the company name. The memory masks what it recognises but recognition is best effort; the responsibility is ours.

learnings.title: Board decks go through Sam before the Thursday cut-off
learnings.body: Send the near-final deck to Sam by Wednesday noon. Thursday 16:00 is the cut-off for the board pack; anything after that waits a month.

learnings.title: Quarterly OKR reviews use the template in Management/OKR/2026
learnings.body: One slide per objective, red-amber-green on the key results, no more than three risks. Reviews are the first Monday of the quarter.

learnings.title: Postgres: timestamp without time zone silently drops the offset
learnings.body: Store instants as timestamptz. A timestamp column keeps the wall-clock text and discards the offset, so data written from servers in different zones cannot be compared. Use AT TIME ZONE only for display.

learnings.title: Docker builds: COPY . before installing deps busts the layer cache
learnings.body: Copy package.json and the lockfile first, install, then COPY the rest. Otherwise every source change reinstalls all dependencies and CI builds take minutes longer.

learnings.title: pytest: tests pass alone but fail together - module-level state leaks
learnings.body: A module-level cache or a monkeypatch without undo leaks between tests. Use fixtures with teardown or monkeypatch, and run with -p randomly to catch order dependence.

learnings.title: Node: JSON.stringify drops undefined and turns Dates into ISO strings
learnings.body: Round-tripping objects through JSON loses undefined fields and Date instances become strings. Use a reviver for dates and explicit null for missing values in API payloads.

learnings.title: YAML: unquoted NO, off, yes become booleans in YAML 1.1 parsers
learnings.body: Country code NO or a value like off is parsed as false by PyYAML and some CI systems. Quote string values in config files.

learnings.title: Python logging: basicConfig does nothing if a handler is already configured
learnings.body: A library that logs at import time installs a handler first, so a later logging.basicConfig is a no-op. Pass force=True or configure logging before importing such libraries.

learnings.title: Excel opens CSV with the system list separator, not always comma
learnings.body: On EU locales Excel saves CSV with semicolons and decimal commas. Sniff the delimiter instead of assuming comma, and parse amounts per locale.

learnings.title: JavaScript: Array.prototype.sort sorts numbers as strings by default
learnings.body: [10, 9, 1].sort() gives [1, 10, 9]. Always pass a comparator (a, b) => a - b for numbers.

learnings.title: HTTP clients: retry only idempotent requests
learnings.body: Automatic retries of POST can create duplicate orders. Retry GET/PUT/DELETE, or send an Idempotency-Key with POST so the server can dedupe.

learnings.title: Feature flags: read them once per request, not per call
learnings.body: Reading a remote flag several times in one request can flip mid-request during a rollout and produce mixed behaviour. Snapshot flags at the start of the request.
